newsitem.title: USA: Ex-governor of Hong Kong to write book.
newsitem.headline: Ex-governor of Hong Kong to write book.

text.p: Christopher Patten, the last colonial governor of Hong Kong, will write a book on the growing economic and political power of China and East Asia for Times Books, the publisher announced Tuesday.
The book will be published next spring, publisher Peter Bernstein said. A spokeswoman would not disclose how much Patten would be paid for the book.
Times Books is a division of Random House.

Patten was governor of Hong Kong for five years and left his post on Monday as the British colony reverted to Chinese rule. He was a popular leader who waged verbal battles with China over democratic reforms for Hong Kong.
His book will discuss the negotiations the British held with the Chinese over election arrangements, civil liberties and rules of law in Hong Kong, the publisher said.

The book also will address such issues as economic growth and democracy, the competitive force Asia may pose to Europe and the United States and how the United States and Europe can learn from Asia's economic successes.
The book will be published separately and simultaneously in England by Harper Collins.
